name: Book of Salvation
summary: This unit's melee attacks have +1 A.

name: Braziers of Judgement
summary: This unit has Stealth, and melee attacks that target it take -1 to hit.

name: Dark Angels Bodyguard
summary: While this unit is within 3" of a friendly Dark Angels Infantry unit, this unit has the Lone Operative ability.

name: Deathwing
summary: This unit's attacks can ignore modifiers to BS and WS, and modifiers to Hit rolls.

name: Emnity for the Unworthy
summary: This unit's attacks that target a CHARACTER unit have +1 to hit rolls.

name: Engulfing Fear (Psychic)
summary: In your Shooting phase, force one enemy unit within 18" of this model to take a Battle-shock test.

name: Engulfing Fear (psychic level 1)
summary: In your Shooting phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do: on a 1, this unit is battle-shocked; and select one enemy unit within 12" of this model, and that unit makes a battle-shock roll with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

name: Enmity for the Unworthy
summary: This unit's attacks against Character units get +1 to the Hit roll.

name: Exemplar of Hate
summary: This unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls.

name: Feared Interrogator
summary: At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy CHARACTER unit within 6" of this model makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

name: Grand Master of the Deathwing
summary: This unit's attacks that target an enemy CHARACTER unit have +1 to wound rolls.

name: Grand Master of the Ravenwing
summary: This unit has Mobile. In your Command phase, you can use this ability; if you do, select one combat doctrine to be active for this unit until the start of your next Command phase.

name: Honour or Death
summary: While this unit contains a Ravenwing Champion, it has +1 to Advance rolls and Charge rolls, and when you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem, that use is -1CP.

name: Icon of Old Caliban
summary: While a friendly Dark Angels unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit has Stealth.

name: Icon of Old Caliban (Aura)
summary: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6" of this unit have the Stealth ability.

name: Inner Circle
summary: Attacks that target this unit have -1 D. This unit cannot be targeted with the Tactical Dreadnought Fortitude stratagem.

name: Intractable Will
summary: In the Fight phase, when a model in this unit is destroyed, if this unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. That model is removed from the battlefield when this unit has fought, or at the end of the phase, whichever comes first.

name: Knights of Caliban
summary: If this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit's melee attacks have [ANTI-MONSTER/VEHICLE 4+].

name: Lightning-fast Manoeuvres
summary: Ranged attacks that target this unit take -1 to wound.

name: Martial Exemplar
summary: While a friendly Dark Angels unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit's melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

name: Martial Exemplar (Aura)
summary: While a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is within 6" of this model, its melee attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

name: Master Strategist
summary: In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one combat doctrine to be active for this unit until the start of your next Command phase, in addition to any other combat doctrine.

name: Masterful Tactician
summary: In your Movement phase, select up to one visible friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within 9" of this model, and select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for that unit until the start of your next Command phase.

name: Mist-wreathed Shadow Realms
summary: In your Command phase, if this unit is unengaged, you can use this ability. If you do: place this unit in strategic reserves; this unit can make an ingress move in your next Movement phase, including in your first turn.

name: No Hiding from the Watchers
summary: While a friendly Dark Angels unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against psychic attacks and mortal wounds.

name: No Hiding From the Watchers (Aura)
summary: While a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is within 6" of this model, it has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

name: Primarch of the First Legion
summary: At the start of your Command phase, choose two Primarch of the First Legion abilities for this model to have until your next Command phase.

name: Stasis Bomb
summary: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, select one visible enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT and Lone Operative units) within 24" of this unit. That unit is slowed until the end of your opponent's next Movement phase. While a unit is slowed, in your opponent's Movement phase, when that unit is selected to move, unless it remains stationary, roll one D6: on a 1-4, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds and has -2" M; on a 5-6, that unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds and has -3" M.

name: Storm of Vengeance
summary: Once per turn, in your opponent's Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit within 6" of this model is destroyed, this model can use this ability. It cannot use this ability when it is itself destroyed. If it does, after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, this model can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks it can only target that enemy unit, and only if that unit is an eligible target.

name: Storm of Vengeance (Once per turn, per unit)
summary: Usable once per turn, per unit. Trigger: in your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if those attacks destroyed a friendly Dark Angels unit within 6" of this unit. If used, this unit shoots using normal shooting, and while doing so it can only target that enemy unit.

name: Strikes of Retribution
summary: In the fight phase, when this model is destroyed, if this unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6. On a 2+, this model is not removed from the battlefield. It is removed from the battlefield when its unit has fought, or at the end of the phase, whichever comes first.

name: Supreme Grand Master
summary: This unit's attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

name: The Emperor’s Shield
summary: When an attack with higher Strength than this model's Toughness is allocated to it, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

name: The Lion Helm
summary: The bearer's unit has a 4+ invulnerable save; once per battle, in any phase, the bearer can summon a Watcher in the Dark to grant that unit Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds until the end of the phase.

name: The Spiritshield Helm
summary: This unit has Feel No Pain 3+ against psychic attacks and against mortal wounds.

name: The Watchers
summary: This unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against psychic attacks and mortal wounds.

name: Watcher in the Dark
summary: Once per battle, in any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model in this unit, this unit can use this ability. Until the end of that phase, models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.

name: Watcher in the Dark (Once per battle, per unit)
summary: Once per battle, per unit. In any phase, when this unit suffers a mortal wound, this unit can use this ability. If it does, this unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

name: Whispers of the Shadow Forest (psychic level 1)
summary: When an enemy unit targets this unit, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do: on a 1, this unit is battle-shocked; attacks that target this unit have -1 to hit rolls until the end of the phase.
